rationale: Full lens roster (blind, edge-case, acceptance, verification-gap) and the standards audit ran cleanly with no coverage gaps; blocking is a missing Alembic migration for the new Provider.allow_user_context column (critical — DB writes/reads fail at runtime) plus two standards violations (commit-format on one commit subject, Optional[bool] vs bool | None on two new fields, both major). 3 findings deferred as pre-existing and out of this ticket's scope (list_tools() debug-log asymmetry since EPMCDME-13260; ProviderService.update()'s truthy-check bug left unfixed for non-allow_user_context fields, deliberately per task brief; no MCP-Connect version gate on the EPMCDME-13260 user_context un-exclusion). 3 findings dismissed as noise/below the emission floor (stale 'unconditionally' doc/docstring wording, a default-lineage concern verified correct by reading toolkit_service.py/access_control.py, and a trivial duplicate UserContext.from_user() call).

standards_review.notes: 17/18 commit subjects match `EPMCDME-####: Description`; commit eba06a3a1 uses a lowercase branch-name-style prefix instead.

findings.title: New override fields use Optional[bool] not bool | None
findings.problem: MCPServerDetails.allow_user_context (assistant.py:199) and UpdateProviderRequest.allow_user_context (provider.py:335) are both typed `Optional[bool]`, using the typing.Optional style the project's code-quality guide documents as superseded.
findings.impact: Violates a documented, blocking project standard (code-quality.md 'Types And Imports'); inconsistent with the modern `X | None` style already used elsewhere in this same diff (client.py, mcp/models.py, user.py additions).

findings.title: Missing Alembic migration for new Provider column
findings.problem: `Provider(table=True)` (provider.py:267, via ProviderBase:260-264) gains a new `allow_user_context` boolean column, but no Alembic migration file was added under `src/external/alembic/versions/` in this diff or anywhere in the branch's commit range.
findings.impact: database-patterns.md requires Alembic migrations for runtime schema creation on persistent tables; without one, any environment that applies schema via the existing migration chain will hit a missing-column error on the first Provider create/update/select after deploy — a broken runtime path, not a cosmetic gap.
findings.recommendation: Add an Alembic revision under src/external/alembic/versions/ adding `allow_user_context BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false` to the `providers` table, following the pattern of the existing single-column-add migrations in that directory.

findings.title: Commit subject breaks the required EPMCDME-#### format
findings.problem: Commit `eba06a3a1` in the review range is subjected `epmcdme-13260-mcp-user-context: add planning artifacts` — a lowercase branch-name-style prefix and lowercase description, not the documented `EPMCDME-####: Description` format.
findings.impact: git-workflow.md's Merge Strategy section requires the ticket-prefixed format for commits in the merge range; a malformed subject breaks that documented, blocking convention.
findings.recommendation: Reword the commit subject to `EPMCDME-13260: Add planning artifacts` (via rebase, before merge).
